title: Phase type for recording a step
statement: For a natural number $k$, types $Q,T,S$, and a record-step index consisting of a stage and its associated data, assign a phase type according to the stage. The state, position, tape-reading, tag-reading, writing, and shifting stages use scan phases carrying, respectively, an optional state, a pair in $	ext{Fin}(3)\times\mathrm{Bool}$, a tuple in $	ext{Bool}\times\mathrm{Option}(	ext{Bool})\times\mathrm{Bool}\times\mathrm{Bool}$, an optional tag, the unit type, or a Boolean; the probe and save stages use the probe and counter-loop state types, the seek and restore stages use $S$, the read stage uses a nested optional Boolean, the counter-update stages use flag phases, and the copying and clearing stages use sweep phases. Every remaining stage uses a seek phase.
